label: Add the updates channel of a guild
summary: Adds column "updates_channel_id" to "Guild" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the nullable column, so the guilds that are there have no updates channel
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."Guild" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "updates_channel_id" int8

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'Guild' AND column_name = 'updates_channel_id') AS "result"
